Intelligence Packs are signed data only. They may improve semantic recall and knowledge, but they cannot add executable code, create canonical signals, activate official domain support, or grant metric/formula authority.

messages.Learning consent withdrawn and contribut: Learning consent withdrawn and contributed learning data removed.
messages.LightBI may download and integrity-check: LightBI may download and integrity-check an update in the background. Installation still requires your action.
messages.LightBI product and service notification: LightBI product and service notifications are stored locally on this device.
messages.Local consent is withdrawn. Remote clean: Local consent is withdrawn. Remote cleanup is pending and will retry automatically.
messages.Local learning consent withdrawn. Removi: Local learning consent withdrawn. Removing contributed learning data…
messages.New connections can be stored in the loc: New connections can be stored in the local encrypted vault; saved profiles never expose their URL or password in the UI.
messages.Official origin is a derived evidence st: Official origin is a derived evidence state. Editable client text, logos, HTTPS and SHA-256 staging alone are not official LightBI authority.
messages.Only the rows currently selected in dril: Only the rows currently selected in drill-through
messages.Optional. Choose a perspective, a focus: Optional. Choose a perspective, a focus below, or combine both.
Perspective controls the business angle. Focus controls the entity at the center of the analysis.

messages.Rank and selected metric tell different: Rank and selected metric tell different stories
messages.Remember this connection in the encrypte: Remember this connection in the encrypted local vault
messages.Replacing a device revokes only its Ligh: Replacing a device revokes only its LightBI account session. It does not delete files or analysis stored on that computer.
messages.SHA-256 protects download/staging integr: SHA-256 protects download/staging integrity only. Official LightBI identity additionally requires the independent REL/ATT evidence and applicable OS publisher identity.
messages.Select chart rows first to enable this s: Select chart rows first to enable this scope
messages.Semantic inference can guide evidence-bo: Semantic inference can guide evidence-bound analysis, but it does not activate official domain support, authorize a metric, or turn a hypothesis into a factual claim.
messages.Skip this to analyze the whole dataset a: Skip this to analyze the whole dataset as usual. Add a focus only when one entity should be at the center of the analysis.
messages.Source evidence is kept in separate shee: Source evidence is kept in separate sheets; LightBI does not blindly join unrelated raw rows.
messages.The focus was found in the full source,: The focus was found in the full source, but this perspective has no reliable numeric metric for a benchmark yet.
messages.The full dataset stays available for com: The full dataset stays available for comparison. This only makes one entity the center of the analysis.
messages.The same registry drives native menu acc: The same registry drives native menu accelerators and in-app shortcuts, so the labels stay consistent.
messages.This chart remains the governed populati: This chart remains the governed population evidence. It is supporting context; the focused benchmark above is the primary readout.
This domain is not officially supported. Analysis remains evidence-bound; unsupported calculations stay unavailable.
messages.This focus is recognized, but no governe: This focus is recognized, but no governed analysis lens is executable for it yet. No chart will be fabricated.
messages.This legacy perspective evidence is reta: This legacy perspective evidence is retained for auditability; it does not replace the active Focus context.
messages.This source has no exact evidence for th: This source has no exact evidence for the selected Focus Subject. LightBI will not infer a cross-source identity match.
messages.Top/Bottom values describe the metric di: Top/Bottom values describe the metric distribution only; LightBI does not infer that a larger value is inherently better unless the governed metric contract says so.
messages.Type an identifier or label to choose th: Type an identifier or label to choose the subject you care about.
messages.Updates install only when you choose to: Updates install only when you choose to apply them.
messages.Use Google or email and password to mana: Use Google or email and password to manage Pro access and devices. Files, SQL and analysis results stay local.
messages.What business angle do you want to inves: What business angle do you want to investigate?
messages.Withdraw Micro Brain learning consent an: Withdraw Micro Brain learning consent and delete contributed learning data? Local learning memory is cleared immediately; remote cleanup retries safely if this device is offline.
messages.Withdraw learning consent & delete contr: Withdraw learning consent & delete contributed data
messages.Your Google or verified email identity a: Your Google or verified email identity anchors entitlement and device slots. Business data stays local.
messages.Your password is correct. Complete the e: Your password is correct. Complete the enabled second factor before LightBI creates a native account session.
messages.Your plan has no free device slot. Light: Your plan has no free device slot. LightBI will never sign out another active device without your approval.

patterns.target: Revenue in the final period increased $1% versus the first period in the file.

patterns.target: Revenue in the final period decreased $1% versus the first period in the file.

patterns.source: ^Có ([\d,.]+) dòng doanh thu cao bất thường theo ngưỡng IQR, nên kiểm tra trước khi ra quyết định\.$
patterns.target: There are $1 unusually high-revenue rows under the IQR rule; review them before making a decision.

patterns.target: $1 contributes $2% of revenue, the largest contribution group.

patterns.target: $1 is the largest group, representing $2% of the analyzed scope.

patterns.target: There are $1 unusually high waiting-time records under the IQR rule.

patterns.target: $1 has the highest positive outcome rate in $2 ($3%, n=$4).
